description: This is a Java source code file defining a serializer class for handling loan adjustment transaction business events within the Finerect project. It converts business event objects into Avro DTOs for serialization purposes, integrating with other services and mappers.

classes.name: LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class converting LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent objects into Avro format for external event handling, utilizing services and mappers to retrieve and map transaction data.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the provided business event is a LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent for serialization.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a LoanAdjustTransactionBusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO, enriching transaction data via services and mapping.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the Avro schema class that this serializer supports, namely LoanTransactionAdjustmentDataV1.

methods.name: getExternalEventCustomDataSerializers
methods.description: Provides the list of external data serializers associated with this event serializer.
